title: Gerente comercial
description:
Objetivo do Cargo

Liderar a estratégia comercial da Astro 34, impulsionando o crescimento de mercado por meio da venda consultiva de instrumentos analíticos de alta tecnologia e serviços de manutenção. O foco será aproximar indústrias e universidades das soluções de ponta representadas pela empresa, garantindo a excelência no atendimento e o alcance das metas de receita.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão Estratégica de Vendas: Planejar e executar o plano comercial anual, definindo metas individuais e coletivas alinhadas à visão da empresa.
  • Liderança de Equipe: Coordenar e capacitar o time de vendas técnicas, fornecendo suporte em negociações complexas e promovendo treinamentos contínuos sobre os novos equipamentos.
  • Venda Consultiva: Gerenciar o funil de vendas (CRM) para equipamentos de alta complexidade (Espectrômetros, Reatores, Analisadores Elementares), garantindo que a solução técnica atenda perfeitamente à necessidade do cliente.
  • Gestão de Parcerias: Manter e estreitar o relacionamento com as fabricantes internacionais representadas pela Astro 34 no Brasil.
  • Expansão de Mercado: Identificar novas oportunidades em setores-chave (Agronegócio, Farmacêutico, Petróleo e Gás) e expandir a base de clientes em universidades e centros de pesquisa.
  • Análise de Desempenho: Monitorar KPIs (taxa de conversão, ticket médio, ciclo de venda) e elaborar relatórios gerenciais para a diretoria.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Administração, Engenharia (Química, Mecânica, Produção), Química ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação em Gestão Comercial ou MBA será um diferencial.
  • Experiência: Vivência comprovada em gestão comercial no segmento B2B, preferencialmente com venda de equipamentos laboratoriais, industriais ou de automação.
  • Habilidades Técnicas:
  • Conhecimento em processos de importação e representação comercial.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CRM.
  • Inglês avançado (essencial para comunicação com parceiros internacionais e leitura de manuais técnicos).
  • Perfil Comportamental: Liderança inspiradora, perfil analítico, excelente capacidade de negociação e foco total em resultados.

O que a Astro 34 oferece (Baseado no mercado)

  • Remuneração fixa + Comissão agressiva por performance.
  • Plano de saúde e benefícios.
  • Oportunidade de atuar com tecnologias de ponta e em um ambiente de inovação constante.

Por que trabalhar na Astro 34?

Ao ingressar na Astro 34, terá a oportunidade de representar marcas líderes globais em inovação científica, participando diretamente do avanço tecnológico da indústria nacional e de centros de pesquisa de ponta.


Ponto importante: é necessário ter experiência em instrumentação analítica. Caso possua essa experiência, envie seu currículo para .

O foco será aproximar indústrias e universidades das soluções de ponta representadas pela empresa, garantindo a excelência no atendimento e o alcance das metas de receita.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão Estratégica de Vendas: Planejar e executar o plano comercial anual, definindo metas individuais e coletivas alinhadas à visão da empresa.
  • Liderança de Equipe: Coordenar e capacitar o time de vendas técnicas, fornecendo suporte em negociações complexas e promovendo treinamentos contínuos sobre os novos equipamentos.
  • Venda Consultiva: Gerenciar o funil de vendas (CRM) para equipamentos de alta complexidade (Espectrômetros, Reatores, Analisadores Elementares), garantindo que a solução técnica atenda perfeitamente à necessidade do cliente.
  • Gestão de Parcerias: Manter e estreitar o relacionamento com as fabricantes internacionais representadas pela Astro 34 no Brasil.
  • Expansão de Mercado: Identificar novas oportunidades em setores-chave (Agronegócio, Farmacêutico, Petróleo e Gás) e expandir a base de clientes em universidades e centros de pesquisa.
  • Análise de Desempenho: Monitorar KPIs (taxa de conversão, ticket médio, ciclo de venda) e elaborar relatórios gerenciais para a diretoria.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Administração, Engenharia (Química, Mecânica, Produção), Química ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação em Gestão Comercial ou MBA será um diferencial.
  • Experiência: Vivência comprovada em gestão comercial no segmento B2B, preferencialmente com venda de equipamentos laboratoriais, industriais ou de automação.
  • Habilidades Técnicas:
  • Conhecimento em processos de importação e representação comercial.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CRM.
  • Inglês avançado (essencial para comunicação com parceiros internacionais e leitura de manuais técnicos).
  • Perfil Comportamental: Liderança inspiradora, perfil analítico, excelente capacidade de negociação e foco total em resultados.

O que a Astro 34 oferece (Baseado no mercado)

  • Remuneração fixa + Comissão agressiva por performance.
  • Plano de saúde e benefícios.
  • Oportunidade de atuar com tecnologias de ponta e em um ambiente de inovação constante.

Por que trabalhar na Astro 34?

Ao ingressar na Astro 34, terá a oportunidade de representar marcas líderes globais em inovação científica, participando diretamente do avanço tecnológico da indústria nacional e de centros de pesquisa de ponta.


Ponto importante: é necessário ter experiência em instrumentação analítica. Caso possua essa experiência, envie seu currículo para .

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional experience in C# and Angular or React.js to support the development, migration, and ongoing evolution of a platform. This role will play a key part in delivering new product initiatives, maintaining existing systems, and implementing a modernized architecture across multiple verticals.

The ideal candidate is technically strong across the stack, comfortable working within an established architectural vision, and proactive in taking ownership of implementation and delivery.


Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI powering solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain full-stack features across web applications and backend services
  • Implement solutions aligned with architectural guidance provided by the architecture team
  • Contribute to the development of new products while maintaining and enhancing existing systems
  • Support the migration of legacy components into a modern microservices-based architecture
  • Build and maintain scalable backend services using C# , .NET , and SQL
  • Develop and maintain front-end functionality using Angular , with the
  • ability to quickly learn and adapt as needed
  • Collaborate across multiple product verticals and support a growing pipeline of new initiatives
  • Take technical ownership of assigned areas, leading implementation efforts and driving work forward
  • Partner closely with Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams to deliver on the broader technical vision


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience as a software engineer in a full-stack capacity
  • Strong backend experience with C# , .NET , and SQL
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining microservices-based systems
  • Front-end development experience, ideally with Angular , or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Experience working within an established architecture and implementing designs created by an architecture team
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work across multiple projects and verticals
  • Proactive, energetic mindset with a willingness to take ownership and lead by example


Preferred Experience

  • Experience participating in large-scale system migrations or platform modernization efforts
  • Exposure to cloud-based environments and distributed systems
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments with multiple concurrent initiatives


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Noções de UX Research e testes de usabilidade

Familiaridade com Maze ou ferramentas de teste remoto

Conhecimento de métricas de usabilidade (eficiência, eficácia, satisfação)

Experiência com o modelo SUM

Experiência em projetos de produtos digitais em escala

Vivência em ambientes ágeis

Revisar e validar protótipos, fluxos e tarefas antes dos testes

Acompanhar testes em campo e apoiar ajustes necessários

Extrair, limpar e organizar dados dos testes

Apoiar o cálculo das métricas de usabilidade e do SUM

Contribuir na análise dos resultados e identificação de insights

Apoiar a construção de relatórios e recomendações para os times de produto

Seguir padrões, templates e boas práticas do SUM, garantindo consistência.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Técnico eletrônico
description:
Buscamos TÉCNICO ELETRÔNICO para trabalhar presencialmente em Cachoeirinha/RS

Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional comprovada, salário entre R$ 2.200,00 (iniciante) até R$ 2.500,00 (pelo menos 2 anos de experiência).

A Schalter é uma empresa fabricante de produtos eletrônicos, também com atuação no segmento da tecnologia da informação, mais especificamente provedora de produtos, serviços e soluções tecnológicas integradas de automação comercial, bancária, industrial e de informática.

Nossa experiência de 34 anos de atuação nos permitiu obter conhecimento e credibilidade para oferecer soluções customizadas para empresas de diversos setores e que se encontram em diferentes estágios de desenvolvimento e porte.

Venha se juntar à nossa equipe, esta pode ser a tua oportunidade se você deseja construir um futuro sólido, sustentável e desenvolver sua carreira.

Principais atividades e responsabilidades

O “Técnico Eletrônico” desempenha um papel fundamental na para manter a linha de produção em funcionamento de maneira eficiente. Suas principais atividades e responsabilidades incluem:

  • Executar a instalação e a manutenção de componentes, sistemas eletrônicos e equipamentos
  • Cooperação com a Equipe de Produção, montagem, manutenção, testes e embalagem de produtos a serem expedidos para clientes
  • Resolução de problemas de produtos e componentes
  • Participar do desenvolvimento de projetos
  • Realizar medições e testes com componentes eletrônicos
  • Executar procedimentos de controle de qualidade

Habilidades desejáveis

  • Proatividade
  • Comunicativo, boa dicção
  • Dinâmico
  • Foco no resultado e obtenção de metas estabelecidas
  • Visão Analítica
  • Agir com equilíbrio emocional
  • Trabalhar com ética
  • A capacidade de trabalhar bem em equipe
  • Ser detalhista aos processos e registros

Requisitos mínimos para o cargo

  • Desejado Curso Técnico em Eletrônica, mecânica ou Informática
  • Conhecimento técnico na solução de problemas em reparos de equipamentos.

Requisitos desejável para o cargo

  • No mínimo 1 ano de experiência

Benefícios:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional (Faixa salaria entre R$ 2.200,00 (iniciante) até R$ 2.500,00 (pelo menos 2 anos de experiência)
  • VT: De acordo com itinerário (Exclusivamente se usar transporte público, mediante regras de vale transporte de acordo com CLT)
  • VR
  • Plano de saúde ambulatorial e odonto após contrato de experiência
  • PPLR
  • Day OFF: Dia de folga como prémio para comemoração do aniversário conforme política definida pela empresa

Tipo de emprego

  • Vinculo:                    CLT
  • Formato:                  Presencial - 44 horas semanais
  • Jornada:                   Segunda a quinta-feira das 08:00 as 12:30 e das 13:30 as 18:00, Sexta-feira das 08:00 as 12:30 e das 13:30 as 17:00
  • Local de trabalho:    Avenida Frederico Augusto Ritter, 520, Cachoeirinha, RS, BR

Setor

  • Área produtiva, se reporta para o gestor da Produção.

Tipo de emprego

  • Tempo integral

Contrato de experiência

  • 90 (noventa) dias

title: Mendix Developer Senior | LowCode
description:
Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto


Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior – Mendix para liderar projetos estratégicos e ser referência técnica no time. Se você tem carreira sólida em tecnologia, experiência mínima de 2 anos com Mendix e gosta de compartilhar conhecimento, essa oportunidade é para você!


O que você vai fazer

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações Mendix, garantindo qualidade e integração.
  • Apoiar decisões de arquitetura e orientar o time em melhores práticas.
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento, com foco em performance e escalabilidade.
  • Ser referência técnica, promovendo aprendizado e evolução contínua.


Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos com Mendix .
  • Conhecimento em integração via APIs , modelagem de dados e versionamento (Git).
  • Experiência com Mendix Studio Pro , Developer Portal e práticas low-code.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Perfil colaborativo e capacidade de orientar equipes.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura escalável , microsserviços e mensageria.
  • Conhecimento em Docker/Kubernetes , práticas DevOps e pipelines CI/CD.
  • Vivência com cloud (AWS, Azure) e integração com serviços externos.
  • Base sólida em Java, JavaScript e princípios S.O.L.I.D.



O que oferecemos:


Você fará parte de equipes diversas e de alto performance, em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Valorizamos a contribuição de todos na criação de soluções e nas decisões estratégicas. Aqui, as pessoas são o nosso diferencial, e somos apaixonados por tecnologia, inovação e evolução contínua.


Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis para pessoas com deficiência!


O time está te esperando, vamos nessa?


#VempraTQI

title: Senior Software (TypeScript/Ruby/React) Engineer
description:
Summary

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help shape and scale a modern web experience for a fast-paced, consumer-facing product team. You’ll work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver elegant, performant, and maintainable applications using TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and React . This role is ideal for someone who possesses a high level of agency, a \"doer\" mentality, and the ability to maintain a full product vision while shipping high-quality code at speed.


Core Requirements :

  • Mastery of TypeScript and React for building complex, scalable web applications.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend development with a proven track record of shipping production-grade software.
  • Experience working with Ruby on Rails (or interest in a product where RoR is core)
  • Prior experience in the Trading, Brokerage, or Wealth Management industries.
  • Demonstrated high level of agency and a proactive \"doer\" mentality, with the ability to hit the ground running and own features end-to-end.
  • Strong product sense and the ability to build for the long term while balancing immediate delivery needs.
  • Excellent understanding of modern frontend architecture, state management, and performance optimization.
  • Solid experience with unit testing and a commitment to maintaining high code quality through thoughtful testing practices.
  • Comfort navigating fast-paced environments and collaborating within cross-functional agile teams.
  • Strong eye for design-to-dev fidelity and a passion for creating fluid, responsive user interfaces.


Nice to Have :

  • Full-stack development experience or a strong understanding of backend systems and API design.
  • Experience working with GraphQL APIs and modern data-fetching libraries.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows for web applications.
  • Exposure to modern CSS-in-JS libraries or advanced styling frameworks.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community, fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career - we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

description:
Data Science / Machine Learning

  • Fluência em inglês ou espanhol.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Matemática, Física, Engenharia ou Estatística.
  • Experiência com Machine Learning, Data Mining e Feature Engineering.

  • Experiência com dados não estruturados e uso de dashboards para visualização e análise.

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)

title: Desenvolvedor React Native
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Código da oportunidade: 57426


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei , venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Desenvolvedor React Native


Responsabilidades Desenvolver e manter aplicações em React Native com foco em qualidade e testabilidade Criar, executar e manter testes unitários e testes integrados (imprescindível)

Atuar na automação de testes, garantindo confiabilidade e estabilidade das entregas Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, QAs e produto para evoluir a estratégia de testes

Apoiar na melhoria contínua de processos, padrões e boas práticas de qualidade


Requisitos (imprescindíveis)

Experiência como Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno(a) React Native em nível profissional

Experiência sólida com testes unitários e testes integrados

Vivência com testes automatizados

Boa base em JavaScript / TypeScript

Mentalidade de qualidade desde o desenvolvimento


Diferenciais

Experiência prévia atuando em Chapter de QA

Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (ex: Jest, Testing Library, Cypress, Detox, etc.) Experiência com CI/CD e pipelines de testes

Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Data Architect (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 6 years of experience as a Data Engineer
  • Strong experience in Data Architecture
  • Hands-on experience with Cloud platforms: Azure, AWS, and/or GCP
  • Experience with Big Data tools and technologies, including Databricks
  • Solid experience with ETL processes and data integration via APIs
  • Experience across the full lifecycle: implementation, development, and maintenance
  • English level B2 or higher
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid, based in Portugal.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP Fiori
description:
Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Nível: Sênior


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori para atuar em projetos estratégicos de modernização e evolução tecnológica no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) .

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções modernas utilizando ABAP Cloud e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 , aplicando boas práticas de clean core e arquitetura extensível.

Além das iniciativas mais modernas, é importante que o profissional possua base sólida em ABAP Clássico , garantindo flexibilidade para atuar em demandas tradicionais quando necessário.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e extensões com ABAP Cloud / RAP integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 .
  • Implementar e manter serviços OData, CDS Views e AMDPs para consumo em interfaces Fiori.
  • Trabalhar em ambiente SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP , aplicando conceitos de clean core e extensibilidade .
  • Apoiar arquitetos e consultores funcionais na definição e entrega de soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir performance, segurança e qualidade de código nas entregas.
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, boas práticas e mentoria técnica para o time.
  • Atuar também, quando necessário, em demandas ABAP Clássico , mantendo soluções legadas e promovendo sua evolução gradativa para o novo modelo.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 5+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento ABAP , com domínio de ABAP Clássico e ABAP Cloud .
  • Experiência sólida com RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) .
  • Domínio de SAP Fiori / SAP UI5 e Fiori Elements .
  • Conhecimento em CDS Views , OData Services , AMDPs e integrações RESTful .
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA e ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento (Eclipse ADT, Git, transportes em BTP ).
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho colaborativo em times ágeis.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) .
  • Experiência com SAP BTP , extensões side-by-side e integrações em nuvem.
  • Certificação SAP ABAP for Cloud ou SAP BTP.
  • Experiência em S/4HANA Cloud (Public ou Private Edition) .

Além das iniciativas mais modernas, é importante que o profissional possua base sólida em ABAP Clássico , garantindo flexibilidade para atuar em demandas tradicionais quando necessário.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e extensões com ABAP Cloud / RAP integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 .
  • Implementar e manter serviços OData, CDS Views e AMDPs para consumo em interfaces Fiori.
  • Trabalhar em ambiente SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP , aplicando conceitos de clean core e extensibilidade .
  • Apoiar arquitetos e consultores funcionais na definição e entrega de soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir performance, segurança e qualidade de código nas entregas.
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, boas práticas e mentoria técnica para o time.
  • Atuar também, quando necessário, em demandas ABAP Clássico , mantendo soluções legadas e promovendo sua evolução gradativa para o novo modelo.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 5+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento ABAP , com domínio de ABAP Clássico e ABAP Cloud .
  • Experiência sólida com RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) .
  • Domínio de SAP Fiori / SAP UI5 e Fiori Elements .
  • Conhecimento em CDS Views , OData Services , AMDPs e integrações RESTful .
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA e ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento (Eclipse ADT, Git, transportes em BTP ).
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho colaborativo em times ágeis.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) .
  • Experiência com SAP BTP , extensões side-by-side e integrações em nuvem.
  • Certificação SAP ABAP for Cloud ou SAP BTP.
  • Experiência em S/4HANA Cloud (Public ou Private Edition) .

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Title: SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER (REMOTE)


About:

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary :


Position Description

This is a remote working opportunity and you can work anywhere as long as you have a strong internet connection and the discipline to work alone. You will be working closely with other DevOPS engineers, software engineers and contributors on the project.


Responsibilities

  • Building and setting up new development tools and infrastructure
  • Understanding the needs of stakeholders and conveying this to developers
  • Working on ways to automate and improve development and release processes
  • Ensuring that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats
  • Identifying technical problems and developing software updates and ‘fixes’
  • Working with software developers and software engineers to ensure that development follows established processes and works as intended


Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency
  • 5+ years experience as DevOPS/SRE at AWS environment
  • Exceptional leadership, time management, facilitation, and organizational skills


Must-Have Technologies

  • ELK Stack
  • Ansible
  • Grafana
  • Terraform
  • Kubernetes
  • Docker
  • Fastly


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company that provides technical expertise, testing, and certification services to the global food and agricultural industry. Their mission is to ensure food safety, quality, and sustainability across international supply chains.


They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering their flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure the software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be asked to perform additional tasks as required, that may or may not be related to their primary duties.


Required Qualifications:


  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


This is a CRT Role at R$18,000/month + Annual Bonus

description:
Job Title: DAX Engineer (Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012)

Industry: Transportation & Supply Chain

Location: Remote


About the Role:

Our client is seeking a skilled DAX Engineer to enhance and maintain their on-prem Microsoft Dynamics AX environment. This role bridges technical development and business operations, working closely with stakeholders across transportation and supply chain functions. The ideal candidate is a Microsoft Dynamics AX specialist with strong technical skills and the ability to translate business needs into practical, scalable solutions.


Key Responsibilities:


Develop, configure, and maintain Microsoft Dynamics AX (AX 2012) solutions to support business operations.


Work within an on-prem AX environment, ensuring stability, reliability, and performance.

Support system integrations, customizations, upgrades, and performance optimizations.

Document system designs, processes, and best practices to maintain operational clarity.


Contribute to the continuous improvement of AX systems and workflows.

Proven experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX (AX 2012).


Hands-on development experience using C# and .NET.


Background as a DAX / Microsoft Engineer, with strong understanding of enterprise systems.


Comfortable in a techno-functional role, engaging both technical and business stakeholders.


Experience supporting on-premise enterprise systems and ensuring operational stability.


Preferred Experience:


Previous exposure to transportation, logistics, or supply chain industries.


Experience with large-scale, enterprise ERP environments.


Understanding of operational workflows in supply chain or freight operations.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.

  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with 30 years of experience, is seeking a Salesforce OEM Application Developer to support a US-based customer. This position collaborates with development teams in the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, focusing on designing, developing, and maintaining a managed Salesforce OEM application.


This role is ideal for someone with deep Salesforce development expertise, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly in English.


About the Role:


As a Salesforce OEM Application Developer, you will work closely with product managers, clients, and internal teams to gather and refine technical requirements, translate business needs into robust application features, and maintain a secure, scalable Salesforce OEM solution. You will develop advanced functionality combining code and configuration, manage integrations and data migrations, troubleshoot application-level issues, and support packaging, versioning, and upgrades of the managed application.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and maintain a managed Salesforce OEM application using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools.
  • Build advanced Salesforce functionality, including complex Flows, triggers, asynchronous processing, and Community/Experience Cloud implementations .
  • Architect scalable and secure solutions aligned with Salesforce OEM/ISV best practices , including multi-tenant considerations and upgrade-safe design.
  • Develop and maintain custom data models, integrations, and automation , ensuring performance, governor-limit compliance, and maintainability.
  • Manage data migration and transformation processes using Apex, ETL tools, and Salesforce APIs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application-level issues including Apex logic, automation conflicts, and deployment errors.
  • Build test classes with strong code coverage and participate in CI/CD and release management activities.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation , including architecture workbooks, developer/admin guides, testing strategies, and deployment protocols.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Administrators and customer technical teams to ensure correct configuration and extension of the OEM application.


Required Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on Salesforce development experience , including Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Proven experience blending programmatic development and declarative configuration for scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Experience designing and implementing advanced Flows, triggers, and automation based on business rules.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, security, permissions, sharing models, and performance optimization .
  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders to design sophisticated user experiences across screens, records, and automation processes.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and modern release practices .
  • Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I/II, Administrator or Advanced Administrator (Platform App Builder preferred).
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills in English.
  • Familiarity with C# and the .NET ecosystem for backend services or integrations.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows for code generation, testing, or documentation.
  • Prior experience building or supporting OEM/ISV applications , including managed packages, AppExchange distribution, or Salesforce Security Review preparation.
  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.

description:

This position collaborates with development teams in the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, focusing on designing, developing, and maintaining a managed Salesforce OEM application.


This role is ideal for someone with deep Salesforce development expertise, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly in English.


About the Role:


As a Salesforce OEM Application Developer, you will work closely with product managers, clients, and internal teams to gather and refine technical requirements, translate business needs into robust application features, and maintain a secure, scalable Salesforce OEM solution. You will develop advanced functionality combining code and configuration, manage integrations and data migrations, troubleshoot application-level issues, and support packaging, versioning, and upgrades of the managed application.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and maintain a managed Salesforce OEM application using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools.
  • Build advanced Salesforce functionality, including complex Flows, triggers, asynchronous processing, and Community/Experience Cloud implementations .
  • Architect scalable and secure solutions aligned with Salesforce OEM/ISV best practices , including multi-tenant considerations and upgrade-safe design.
  • Develop and maintain custom data models, integrations, and automation , ensuring performance, governor-limit compliance, and maintainability.
  • Manage data migration and transformation processes using Apex, ETL tools, and Salesforce APIs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application-level issues including Apex logic, automation conflicts, and deployment errors.
  • Build test classes with strong code coverage and participate in CI/CD and release management activities.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation , including architecture workbooks, developer/admin guides, testing strategies, and deployment protocols.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Administrators and customer technical teams to ensure correct configuration and extension of the OEM application.


Required Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on Salesforce development experience , including Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Proven experience blending programmatic development and declarative configuration for scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Experience designing and implementing advanced Flows, triggers, and automation based on business rules.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, security, permissions, sharing models, and performance optimization .
  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders to design sophisticated user experiences across screens, records, and automation processes.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and modern release practices .
  • Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I/II, Administrator or Advanced Administrator (Platform App Builder preferred).
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills in English.
  • Familiarity with C# and the .NET ecosystem for backend services or integrations.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows for code generation, testing, or documentation.
  • Prior experience building or supporting OEM/ISV applications , including managed packages, AppExchange distribution, or Salesforce Security Review preparation.
  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.

title: Privacy Counsel (Full Time, Remote Position)
description:
About VeraSafe:

VeraSafe is an innovative and successful U.S. headquartered privacy and cybersecurity compliance consulting firm and law firm. Due to rapid growth and increased demand for our international privacy and technology compliance and legal services, VeraSafe is seeking creative, motivated, and collaborative attorneys to join our team, regardless of prior work experience or education background. This is a fully remote position and will remain a fully remote position.


Watch / listen to learn more about VeraSafe: Check out our podcast!

Apple Podcast :

YouTube :

Spotify:


VeraSafe is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work©, with 96% of our employees affirming that we are truly a great place to work . This means we foster trust, collaboration, and a positive work environment. We are committed to maintaining this standard of meaningful work, work-life balance, and a supportive community. Check out our great benefits, listed at the end of this job description.


VeraSafe frequently hires for attorney and consultant positions on a rolling basis. We are growing rapidly and seek to proactively build a strong talent pool to meet sustained, increasing client demand.


About the Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for an attorney with 4-6 years of experience who wants to join a team working on the cutting edge of privacy and data protection, and who wants to further develop a practice in an in-demand, high-tech area of law. We are inundated with business from clients who love the way we advise on privacy compliance (hence the need for you!).


While this role requires professional experience in privacy law , we are prepared to welcome you to our team with a robust and established onboarding and training process. We typically advance people more quickly than your typical law firm, and we do it on an individual basis (no lockstep promotions or compensation).


Note : We include skills assessments in the recruitment for this position. We know this is a burden, but we think it’s worth it, and we appreciate you taking the time to complete it. We’ve found it enables us to find the best attorneys, regardless of their experience, where they went to law school, or where they were trained. We want smart, kind, creative lawyers, plain and simple, and this assessment is a crucial part of our ability to hire this way.


We are not your typical legal job. We use project managers to keep our remote team organized and our projects streamlined and on-track. We encourage our team members to travel and to make use of our ability to work as digital nomads, whether that means spending a few months abroad or on extended trips to be near family. We collaborate closely (you won’t feel like you’re working in isolation) and we actively encourage sharing of credit for work well done, resources, and advice (and penalize the reverse). We are not biglaw. We do top-notch work for interesting clients, yet we pride ourselves on our team members being happy, with time and energy for a life outside of work, which we believe makes us better attorneys who don’t burn out.


The bottom line: If you want to learn or go deeper practicing privacy law, if you want to practice in a problem-solving environment focused on giving excellent and yet actionable advice, if you want to work with a global team of friendly, brilliant people, if you want the flexibility to work in a way that makes sense to you, please apply!


Responsibilities Include:

  • Assessing client information systems for compliance with data protection laws and regulations
  • Drafting data protection agreements, addenda, and amendments
  • Advising clients on privacy-related product improvements
  • Researching legal issues and composing legal opinions/memoranda
  • Writing privacy law related articles and blog posts
  • Assisting in the development of in-house legal templates
  • Contributing to the development of internal procedures and methodologies
  • Collaborating with a team of intellectual peers who value cooperation and community


What We Need From You

Need to Have:

  • License to practice law (active and in good standing) in your jurisdiction
  • Experience in privacy/data protection of 4-6 years or experience in the field of life sciences of at least 4 years
  • Team player, interested in contributing to a growing enterprise
  • Strong writing/editing skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work remotely
  • Willingness to learn new skills and receive direction and feedback from partners
  • Willingness to pursue privacy certifications (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPM)


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working in a law firm
  • Previous contract drafting and negotiation experience
  • Privacy certifications of some kind (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPP/US, specialty from law school, etc.)
  • Professional involvement in the privacy and/or data security space (attendance at privacy conferences; membership or publication in the IAPP, etc.)


Key Competencies:

  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a strong work ethic
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable using a variety of software applications
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage your own schedule in order to work successfully with international teams and meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently and fully deliver on all commitments


VeraSafe’s Excellent Benefits Include:

  • Work from almost anywhere with Wi-Fi
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid holidays
  • Annual bonuses
  • Membership in the International Association of Privacy Professionals (IAPP) and IAPP exam fee reimbursement (CIPP/E)
  • Flexible working schedule in some roles
  • Reimbursement for certain personal flight ticket
  • Company laptop provided


Other Benefits:

  • Tremendous professional development growth opportunities in the privacy, data protection, and cybersecurity niche
  • The chance to have a long-lasting effect on a small but growing international business
  • Work in an open environment with a team that respects your ideas and contributions
  • Occasional opportunities to travel in North America and Europe

description:
Established in 1996 and rebranded to Scout in 2024, we built our foundation on planning meetings for numerous organizations within the life sciences sector (Scout Meetings). In response to emerging industry needs, we expanded our services to include Scout Clinical, one of the top providers of clinical trial patient travel and reimbursements, and Scout Academy, our secure, online, on-demand learning management system that ensures global compliance.


Scout is recognized as a leader in our field for innovation in service, attention to detail, our stellar team members, and making the complex easier. If this interests you, we’d love to have you join our rapidly growing team!


Position Summary:

The Manager of Site Strategy and Engagement is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with clinical research sites, ensuring successful site engagement, and performance throughout the clinical trial lifecycle. This role involves collaborating with clinical operations teams, ensuring the utilization of the services scoped, and working to enhance site satisfaction and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:

  • Site Engagement: Identify, assess, and engage with potential clinical research sites in studies contracted to use Scout services, ensuring they are aware of the service and have everything needed to optimize use of the portal.
  • Site Support: Provide guidance and direction to sites and operations team members to drive strategy for continued use of the portal.
  • Site/Study Utilization Monitoring: Monitor site utilization throughout the trial, ensuring portal use and proactively addressing any issues or concerns that may arise at the site level.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Project Managers, Patient Lesions, Site staff, and sponsors, to ensure alignment on site-related needs.
  • Site Relationship Management: Cultivate long-term, productive relationships with clinical sites. Regularly check in with sites to assess their needs, gather feedback, and improve site engagement strategies.
  • Problem Solving & Issue Resolution: Anticipate, identify, and resolve any issues or obstacles at the site level to ensure continued use of the portal.
  • Regional Client Support: Support client conversations with regional specific expertise. Gather local market insights including challenges and recommend how Scout can best support or solve them.
  • Marketing for the region: Support marketing with drafting messaging with an emphasis on local, cultural, economic and regulatory considerations.
  • Complete all required initial and ongoing training within a reasonable or provided timeframe.


The ideal candidate will have the following experience, skills, and knowledge:

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in clinical research or clinical trial management, with a focus on site management or clinical site engagement.
  • Strong understanding of clinical trial processes, regulations, and industry best practices.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build rapport with diverse stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple sites and projects simultaneously, with strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese (spoken and written)

title: Analista de Dados Jr.
description:
O Analista de BI Júnior, com foco em analise e visualização de dados, responsável pela criação de índices estatísticos, pela gestão e limpeza de bases de dados e pela prestação de apoio de retaguarda, tanto a nível do desenvolvimento como da manutenção. Além disso, ele/ela implementa sistemas de automação e alertas que melhoram a eficiência, reduzem os tempos de auditoria e garantem a integridade e disponibilidade dos dados. Ele/ela também tem conhecimento de plataformas como Excel, Looker e Power Bi para relatórios e relatórios.


Principais Atribuições:


  • Capacidade de gerar insights e apoiar a tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Proficiência em Power BI, Looker e Excel (é necessário pelo menos um avançado);
  • Visualização de dados: Capacidade de criar visualizações claras e eficazes, facilitando a interpretação dos dados por equipas não técnicas;
  • Conhecimento em Google Analytics;
  • Comunicação eficaz: Capacidade de apresentar análises e resultados a diferentes públicos, tanto técnicos como não técnicos;
  • Colaboração interdisciplinar: Experiência de trabalho com equipas multifuncionais para alinhar a análise de dados com as necessidades estratégicas;
  • Capacidade para avaliar e contextualizar dados: Capacidade para interpretar a informação no contexto;
  • Capacidade para identificar padrões e tendências: Capacidade para detectar alterações ou movimentos significativos nos dados que possam influenciar a estratégia;
  • Abordagem analítica com sentido prático: capacidade de propor soluções eficazes baseadas em dados, tendo em conta as implicações e as necessidades.


Requisitos


  • Python e SQL para desenvolvimentos e processamento de dados;
  • Experiência com Google Analytics e Big Query;
  • Conhecimentos de estatística e matemática (desejável):
  • Conhecimento de estatística.

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the \"Control Room\" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s \"Visualizations\" and that the \"Data Pipelines\" are reliably deployed by DevOps.


What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The \"Expert\": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.


Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.


Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud


Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Fully Remote position.

Product Service Line: Landmark Software & Services

Full Time / Part Time: Full Time

title: Pessoa Analista de DP Sênior
description:
Sobre a empresa


A Oficina é parceira estratégica na criação de reputação e relacionamento, por meio de histórias e causas que transformam o país.


Em 2025 lançamos um novo modelo de negócios que integra a agilidade de uma agência, a profundidade estratégica de uma consultoria e a força de uma atuação em rede.

Nesse contexto, nasceu a Rede de Reputação e Influência , a primeira Community as a Service (CaaS) de Reputação e Influência do Brasil. A iniciativa reúne 40 empresas parceiras com atuação regional e nacional, combinando tecnologia, inteligência e colaboração para antecipar cenários e apoiar decisões com agilidade e precisão.


Nos pautamos em valores como respeito, diversidade, inquietude, ética, excelência no atendimento e trabalho em equipe. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é colaborativo, inovador e orientado a resultados, com modelo híbrido, plano de carreira estruturado e investimento contínuo no desenvolvimento de pessoas.


Responsabilidade e atribuições


  • Executar e consolidar a folha de pagamento;
  • Conferir encargos e recolhimentos;
  • Executar admissões e rescisões complexas;
  • Controlar obrigações recorrentes;
  • Gerar relatórios operacionais e gerenciais;
  • Orientar tecnicamente a equipe;
  • Atender auditorias operacionais;
  • Manter controles e documentações atualizadas.


Requisitos e qualificações


Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Gestão de RH ou áreas correlatas.


Experiência com: Lançamentos de dados, verificação e fechamento da folha de pagamento, encerramento dos encargos mensais (FGTS, INSS, IRRF), processamento dos relatórios gerenciais da folha, contabilização, provisionamento, 13º salário, suporte em gestão de benefícios, controle de ponto, rescisão e férias, aplicação da CLT e CCT, envio de leiautes e fechamento do SPED e-Social, DCTF Web, RPA, tratamento de afastamentos pelo INSS, envio das obrigações anuais - DIRF e outras rotinas pertinentes à área de administração de pessoal.


Aqui, o compromisso com a diversidade e inclusão é transversal à estratégia da empresa: todas as vagas são destinadas também a mulheres, pessoas pretas, indígenas, LGBTQIAP+, pessoas com deficiência e profissionais 40+.


Fazer parte da Oficina é integrar um time que constrói, de forma ética, inovadora e colaborativa, a Nova Era da Reputação e Influência no Brasil.
